ns0:svg.ns0:title: Odd- and even-rank timing of four exact Kloosterman methods
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Two panels fix field degree N at 8 and 16. Ranks L are 3, 4, 7, 8, 15, 16, 23, 24, 31, and 32. Every point retains its true linear rank coordinate; tick labels group adjacent odd and even ranks. Filled markers indicate odd rank and open markers indicate even rank. Logarithmic time axes show medians and observed minimum–maximum ranges of three fresh processes, including initialization and four exact queries. All 80 plotted method/input points and 240 individual times are retained in the adjacent CSV.
